第1264章 为师有些累了（第1页）
他修仙至今，年少时曾亲眼见证仙庭陨落，参与过天地易主。
但像龟龟这般不要脸的，却是第一次见。
赵灵更是忍无可忍：“说这么多，你能寻到主人具体位置吗？”
龟龟瞬间蔫了，吞吞吐吐犹犹豫豫道：“若此地真与帝江有关，恐怕……”
龟龟立刻改口道：“恐怕有极大的难度！
可龟龟虽然老了，不在巅峰状态，但事关主人安危，龟龟义不容辞！
洛师姐放心，龟龟纵是拼上这条老命，也绝对会找到主人！”
这跟那即将到来的桃花运绝无关系。
它龟龟一身正气，心中只有主人，才不是见色眼开的色龟龟。
洛玉深深‘望’了龟龟一眼：“若能寻到师父跟师弟，给你记头功。”
龟龟立刻站直身体，表情无比肃穆，大喊道：“忠！
这小王八在做什么？明明只是简单两个字，却有莫名气势萦绕，就连面相都有些改变了。
仿佛从原来的胆小猥琐之辈，变成了侠肝义胆忠心之人。
“只要钱给够，仙帝的底裤也能算！”
龟龟口中嘟嘟囔囔，开始全身心投入的卜卦，这次它身周没有缭绕任何白色雾气。
那都是没踏入推演大道的外行人，才会做的事。
精通其一者，已然能在修仙界拥有地位。

而作为四道扛把子的龟龟，自是手拿把掐。
而某个无人在意的角落，似乎有人被遗忘掉了。
有种走夜路的时候，路旁草丛有陌生的目光在窥探一般。
若是还好，若不是的话，那恐怕就有些遭了……
苏清欢也察觉到逆徒的异样，犹豫少许，她席地而坐，轻轻拍了拍大腿，柔声开口道：“无玄，来。”
叶凡没有犹豫，躺在师父那充满弹性的修长美腿上，鼻尖传来阵阵沁人心脾的香气。
一切的负面情绪，都被轻柔抚去，叶凡只觉得心安。
苏清欢轻轻揉捏着叶凡眉心，温声道：“无玄，等到仙界移民彻底安稳，等到我们师徒三人寻到破境之法，便能一劳永逸的解决掉黄仲天，你也就不用与妻女分别。”
苏清欢红唇微张，似是想要说什么。
可最后还是没能说出口，只是微微笑了笑。
叶凡握住苏清欢的手，一开始很轻。
可随着那只柔荑想要抽离，叶凡越握越紧。
他直视着苏清欢眼睛，一字一句道：“师父。”
许是察觉到叶凡可能要说不合师徒身份的话，苏清欢眼神闪躲：“嗯？无玄，为师……为师有些累了。”

Chapter 1264 I’m a little tired of being a teacher (page 1)
He has been cultivating immortality to this day. When he was young, he witnessed the fall of Immortal Court and participated in the change of ownership of heaven and earth.
But this is the first time I have seen someone as shameless as Guigui.
Zhao Ling couldn't bear it anymore: "After talking so much, can you find the specific location of the master?"
Guigui instantly wilted and said hesitantly: "If this place is really related to Dijiang, I'm afraid..."
Turtle immediately changed his words and said: "I'm afraid it will be extremely difficult!
But although Guigui is old and not in peak condition, the safety of his owner is related, and Guigui is obligated to do so!
Senior Sister Luo, don't worry, even if Guigui risks his life, he will definitely find his master! "
This has nothing to do with the upcoming love fortune.
The turtle is upright and only has his master in his heart, and he is not a lustful turtle.
Luo Yu took a deep look at Gui Gui and said, "If I can find my master and junior brother, I will give you the first credit."
Turtle immediately stood up straight with an extremely solemn expression and shouted: "Loyalty!
What is this little bastard doing? It was just two simple words, but there was an inexplicable aura lingering around it, and even the appearance changed a little.
It seems that he has changed from a timid and wretched person to a brave and loyal person.
"As long as you give me enough money, even the Immortal Emperor's underwear will count! "
The turtle muttered in his mouth and began to devote himself to the divination. This time, there was no white mist surrounding him.
Those are things that only laypeople who have never stepped into the avenue of deduction would do.
Those who are proficient in one of them can already have a status in the world of immortality.
And as the leader of the Four Paths, Gui Gui naturally has the handle in his hand.
And somewhere in a corner that no one cares about, someone seems to have been forgotten.
It's like walking at night and seeing strange eyes peering into the grass beside the road.
If it's okay, if not, then I'm afraid something will happen...
Su Qinghuan also noticed something strange about the traitor, and after a little hesitation, she sat on the floor, patted her thigh gently, and said softly: "Wuxuan, come here. "
Ye Fan did not hesitate, lying on the master's long and elastic legs, with bursts of refreshing aroma coming from the tip of his nose.
All the negative emotions were gently caressed away, and Ye Fan only felt at ease.
Su Qinghuan gently kneaded the center of Ye Fan's eyebrows and said warmly: "Wuxuan, when the immigrants in the fairy world are completely stable, and when the three of us, master and disciple, find a way to break the boundary, we can get rid of Huang Zhongtian once and for all, and you won't have to separate from your wife and daughter. "
Su Qinghuan's red lips parted slightly, as if she wanted to say something.
But in the end, he couldn't say it out loud, so he just smiled.
Ye Fan held Su Qinghuan's hand, very gently at first.
But as the catkin tried to pull away, Mark's grip became tighter and tighter.
He looked directly into Su Qinghuan's eyes and said word by word: "Master. "
Perhaps sensing that Ye Fan might say something inappropriate for his master-disciple status, Su Qinghuan's eyes dodged: "Huh? Wu Xuan, my teacher... my teacher is a little tired. "
